source: How much does it cost in fees to buy a property in Spain
headline: Buying in Spain?
Budget 12-14% extra.

rows.label: Transfer tax
rows.detail: New builds pay 10% VAT plus a document fee instead.

rows.label: Agent fees
rows.detail: In Madrid 3% is typical, and the seller pays it.

rows.label: The rest
rows.detail: A lawyer adds more, essential for rural property.
